<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
$numericString = new class {
    public function __get(mixed $incoming): float|int|string {
        if ($incoming === "bad") { echo "NUM_ENTER;"; return true; }
        $incoming = false;
        return "7";
    }
};
$selector = "value";
echo $numericString->$selector === "7" ? "STRING;" : "BAD_STRING;";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = $numericString->bad === "7"; }
catch (TypeError $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $selector === "value" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_SELECTOR;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
$literal = new class {
    public function __get(?string $incoming): null|int|true {
        if ($incoming === "bad") { echo "BOOL_ENTER;"; return false; }
        if ($incoming === "nil") { return null; }
        return true;
    }
};
$selector = "value";
echo $literal->$selector === true ? "TRUE;" : "BAD_TRUE;";
echo $literal->nil === null ? "NULL;" : "BAD_NULL;";
$destination = 24;
try { $destination = $literal->bad === true; }
catch (TypeError $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; }
echo $destination === 24 ? "KEEP_LITERAL;" : "BAD_LITERAL_STORE;";
echo $selector === "value" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_SELECTOR;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
$broad = new class {
    public function __get(int|string $incoming): null|string|int|float|bool {
        if ($incoming === "float") { return 2.5; }
        return false;
    }
};
$selector = "float";
echo $broad->$selector === 2.5 ? "FLOAT;" : "BAD_FLOAT;";
echo $broad->value === false ? "FALSE;" : "BAD_FALSE;";
echo $selector === "float" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_SELECTOR;";
echo "DONE;";
